provenance.source: The Phase 1 guideline describes Processor B as a 7-qubit heavy-hex-inspired graph and a contemporary compilation baseline, without an edge list. The undirected edges here are the published CX coupling of the 7-qubit IBM Quantum Lagos device, read from Qiskit IBM Runtime props_lagos.json pairs cx0_1, cx1_2, cx1_3, cx3_5, cx4_5, and cx5_6. That fragment is a tree, not a 6-cycle, and it is not a tracing of the qualitative challenge slide. It is a replaceable stand-in, not an organizer-issued Processor B definition. Device calibration data from Lagos are not used. Noise numbers match the illustrative Challenge Guide section 10 model used for Processor A so the noisy comparison is not confounded by unequal error rates.
provenance.noise_source: Challenge Guide section 10 illustrative noise model, not ibm_lagos calibration data.
